newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Acer limit-up on ex-right day.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Acer limit-up on ex-right day.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc soared limit-up at mid-session on Friday, its ex-right day, indicating what brokers called strong market confidence in the company's outlook.
Acer, the world's seventh-largest microcomputer maker, issued a stock dividend or bonus issue of T$2.5 per share, paying 250 free shares per 1,000 shares held.
After 85 minutes at 0225 GMT, the company's share price was up the daily seven percent limit or T$5 at T$79.50.
Trade volume was a heavy 20.61 million shares.
Some brokers said they did not expect the post ex-right jump to last more than one session.
"Electronic shares already have risen too much in the past month or so," said Oliver Fang, senior analyst for National Securities.
"While investors may be optimistic about the PC market in the long run, they likely will change focus to other sectors for now," Fang said.
Acer has set a 1997 net profit forecast of T$4 billion on sales of T$77.7 billion.
